title: Several weeks later
text:
Several weeks later. Followed instruction completely.
I purchased these but also used some of my own collected from my own fruit
Comparison the seeds I got from store bought organic food germinated nd are ready for planting ( started 1 week after) The ones from here are a no go nothing noting the the color change in seeds and no growth no germination. The seeds are duds or are nothing at all. I do not recommend and would not waste my money on them!!! PS the Apple seeds included are crab apples not for eating!
